authorization: User requests a small model-parameter refinement, then one manual new record for testing. Offline parameters only; no controller change or assistant hardware access.
localParameterBounds: Intersection with +/-10percent of each positive R82 parameter; inertiaEta within +/-0.02 absolute. Same bound for every record; no per-record parameters.
objective: Unchanged R82 full-record mean-position and differential waveforms plus two task RMS targets, now averaged equally over all four retained calibration records. Preserve every before/after result, including regressions. Select lowest cumulative objective including unchanged R82 as an option. No claim of global optimum or validation on training data.

optimizer.method: Bounded deterministic Nelder-Mead, one local seed

recordingLimitations: T1 completion tail6.88s; Q2run03 tail7.08s and one missing native point. Their full motion/hold snapshots independently CRC verified; limitations retained, absent point not imputed. Q2run04 strictly qualified.
newPhysicalTest: One unchanged manual Q2run05 after candidate frozen. Test frozen parameters first; no automatic refit or repeated attempts.
